title: R dependency floor with two components
description: DESCRIPTION declares an `R (>= X.Y)` floor with no patch level. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `R (>= X.Y)` floor with no patch level.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `R (>= X.Y)` floor with no patch level.
limitation: It matches an `R (>= X.Y)` floor with no patch level in the parsed DESCRIPTION; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
